Magid Magid ( / ˈ m æ dʒ ɪ d ˈ m æ dʒ ɪ d / , born 26 June 1989), also known as Magid Mah and Magic Magid , [ 1 ] [ 2 ] is a Somali-British activist and politician who served as the Lord Mayor of Sheffield from May 2018 to May 2019. His appointment attracted significant media attention, as he is the first ethnic- Somali , the youngest-ever, and the first Green Party councillor to hold the role. [ 3 ] [ 4 ] [ 5 ] [ 6 ] [ 7 ] In May 2019, he was elected to the European Parliament as Green Party MEP for Yorkshire and the Humber . [ 8 ]
